svg.title: Space Drums roadmap
svg.desc: Twenty phases from project definition to the ablation study, all delivered with code, tests and a gate record. A light runs along the track and lights each phase in turn; at the end the final-release badge appears: standing four-pad kit, seven-piece kit and AR view.
svg.text: ROADMAP · 20 PHASES · COMPLETE · EACH ONE CLOSED WITH A GATE RECORD
